validity_findings: Per-hit metric at n0 cannot distinguish WebMCP from RAG by construction: both systems hit the 50-tok verify path at exact repeat (n0), and the frozen per_hit formula explicitly excludes retrieval (200 tok) and tool_lookup (15 tok) costs. WebMCP/RAG per_hit ratio at n0 is ~1.005 not because WebMCP fails, but because the metric isolates step costs where both are identical. This is a frozen design limitation, not an execution error. The hypothesis expected <=0.85 at n0, but the metric makes this impossible when both systems hit at n0.

Residual length confounding despite per_hit isolation: pooled |rho_length| = 0.269 (WebMCP) and 0.355 (Spider) exceed the 0.20 threshold; per-stratum |rho_length| reaches 0.365 (WebMCP) and 0.560 (Spider) vs required <0.20. This indicates the per_hit formula does not fully isolate step cost from task length variation (L=8-14 across families).

ECE bins: 4 empty bins (indices 0,1,2,3) observed vs 3 disclosed in prereg. Confidence_std=0.36 >0.05 and bootstrap upper=0.17 <=0.18, so calibration gate C1 passes, but the discrepancy is a minor validity note.

TTL/ETag probe independence from novelty: deterministic map seeded 42 yields ~50% stale uniformly across novelty levels, decoupling probe freshness from residual novelty. Real CDN freshness correlates with novelty (fresh at n0 ~1.0). This is disclosed as a validity threat; probe_novelty correlation unmeasured.

Proxy-only ceiling: file-based synthetic WebArena-Verified v2 192/36 census via actual kernel.distill_parameterized, not Docker BrowserGym 2000-node 1280x720 full-DOM. rho_proxy_real unmeasured. All costs branch-derived via MockEnv. This bounds the claim ceiling to the file-proxy setting.
WebMCP registry 714/2147 is synthetic proxy (shopXX.example.com patterns) not real OpenAPI discovery. tool_lookup 15 tok optimism vs real auth/scope discovery cost disclosed.
baseline_findings: B-COLD: flat per_hit ~504.7 across all n, |rho|~0 as expected. Valid cold baseline.
B-RAG-EMBED: per_hit rises from 54.7 at n0 to 504.8 at n1 proportionally, confirming orthogonal families break retrieval (hitRate_n1=0.387 not 1.0). Valid retrievable baseline.
B-STAGEHAND-CACHE: hitRate 1.0 at n0 per_hit ~54.7, 0 at n>=0.25 -> COLD. Valid DOM-hash cache baseline.
B-TERX-REPLAY: hitRate 1.0 at n0 per_hit ~54.7, 0 at n>=0.25 -> COLD. Valid replay baseline. TERX ratios claimable because frontierHitRate=0.387 != 1.0 (artifact gate not triggered).
P-SPIDER-MEA-BATCHED: reproduces parent 1.12-type failure at n0 (ratio 1.103 vs RAG), confirming honest cost accounting and batched MEA overhead dominance. Valid contrast SUT.
All baselines use identical 192-task splits, same QCR frozen bank, same probe/verify fallback, honest branch-derived costs. No starvation detected.
claim_ceiling: C-PRODUCT-ECON FALSIFIED on WebArena-Verified v2 192/36 orthogonal file-proxy census at f=10 with honest summed-counters cost. WebMCP O(1) tool discovery (714 sites/2147 tools, 15 tok lookup) does NOT achieve per_hit <=0.85 vs RAG at n0 (ratio 1.005) due to frozen per_hit metric excluding retrieval/tool_lookup costs where both hit 50-tok verify path. rho_novelty_per_hit=0.363 <0.60 and |rho_length| per-stratum >0.20 fail correlation gates. All positive controls PASS (orthogonal Jaccard 0.0 <0.30 verified, binding 1.0, probe saving 0.328, auditor blockRate 1.0, cache TRAIN-warmed 0.86, calibration non-vacuous). Null controls PASS (no leak, causal ablations). Measurement is VALID (COMPLETE not MEASUREMENT_INVALID). Bounded REJECTED for WebMCP 714/2147 + MEA batched on this proxy setting only; not global falsification (may transfer with richer DOM, f=100, HS256 substrate, larger registry). No PRODUCT_CORE promotion without Docker 2000-node replication and rho_proxy_real>=0.50.
